hook_line: US LOSES MEASLES ELIMINATION STATUS AFTER 26 YEARS AS CASES PASS 5,400

hook_stat.sub: Confirmed US cases in 2026, the most in any year since 1991

stats.label: Infections in people unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination status

diaspora_bullets: For Indian families in the United States, the practical step is a records check, not alarm
The CDC schedule is a first MMR dose at 12 months and a second at 4 to 6 years
news_summary: The Pan American Health Organization announced on November 17 that the United States has lost the measles elimination status it held since 2000, after the virus circulated uninterrupted for more than a year.
payoff: A country must stop ongoing outbreaks and then show that no one caught measles within its borders for a full year.
